__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRESQL
__inputs.label: PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: Postgres datasource pointing at the secops_dashboard database

title: Endpoint & Identity
description: Falcon sensor coverage and detections, Falcon Identity Protection risk, Entra ID risk/MFA and sign-in activity.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND last_seen < now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Reduced functionality mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND lower(rfm) = 'yes'

panels.description: Sensors in RFM -- usually an unsupported kernel/OS build. Protection is degraded.

panels.title: Unmanaged assets seen

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Devices Falcon sensors saw on the network that have no sensor themselves.

panels.title: Sensor coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE managed) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) FROM assets WHERE NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Managed / (managed + unmanaged-but-seen). Only as complete as Discover's visibility.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND containment ILIKE 'contain%'

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(managed_hosts) AS "Managed", sum(unmanaged_assets) AS "Unmanaged", sum(stale_sensors) AS "Stale sensors" FROM daily_asset_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT hostname AS "Host", site_label AS "Site", product_type AS "Type", os_version AS "OS", sensor_version AS "Sensor", rfm AS "RFM", last_seen AS "Last seen", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_seen) / 86400.0, 1) AS "Days silent" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND (last_seen < now() - interval '7 days' OR lower(rfm) = 'yes') ORDER BY last_seen LIMIT 200

SELECT coalesce(hostname, array_to_string(ips, ', ')) AS "Asset", site_label AS "Site", platform AS "Platform", os_version AS "OS", last_seen AS "Last seen", site_matched_by AS "Site matched by" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE status <> 'closed' AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE status <> 'closed' AND severity = 'critical' AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM closed_at - created_at) / 3600.0))::numeric, 1) FROM security_alerts WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND site_label IN ($site) AND closed_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND closed_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1
SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE status = 'new' AND created_at < now() - interval '24 hours' AND site_label IN ($site)

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical') AS "Critical", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'high') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'medium') AS "Medium", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'low') AS "Low" FROM security_alerts WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(tactic, '(none)') AS "Tactic", count(*) AS "Alerts", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity IN ('critical','high')) AS "Crit/High" FROM security_alerts WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT created_at AS "Created", severity AS "Severity", status AS "Status", name AS "Alert", coalesce(hostname, user_name) AS "Host / user", site_label AS "Site", tactic AS "Tactic", product AS "Product", link AS "Link" FROM security_alerts WHERE status <> 'closed' AND site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, created_at LIMIT 200
SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND risk_severity = 'high' AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND risk_severity = 'medium' AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND enabled AND password_last_change < now() - interval '365 days' AND site_label IN ($site)

SELECT f.factor_type AS "Factor", count(DISTINCT f.entity_id) AS "Accounts" FROM identity_risk_factors f JOIN identity_entities e ON e.source = f.source AND e.entity_id = f.entity_id WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, replace(metric, 'factor:', '') AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM daily_identity_metrics WHERE metric LIKE 'factor:%' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Identity remediation list

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(e.upn, e.display_name) AS "Account", e.sam_account_name AS "sAMAccountName", e.domain AS "Domain", e.site_label AS "Site", e.risk_severity AS "Severity", round(e.risk_score::numeric, 2) AS "Score", string_agg(f.factor_type, ', ' ORDER BY f.factor_type) AS "Risk factors", e.enabled AS "Enabled", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - e.password_last_change) / 86400.0) AS "Password age (days)", e.ou AS "OU" FROM identity_entities e LEFT JOIN identity_risk_factors f ON f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.site_label IN ($site) AND e.risk_severity IN ('high','medium') GROUP BY e.source, e.entity_id, e.upn, e.display_name, e.sam_account_name, e.domain, e.site_label, e.risk_severity, e.risk_score, e.enabled, e.password_last_change, e.ou ORDER BY e.risk_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

panels.description: Work list for the service desk (users) and cyber/systems (privileged/service accounts).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM entra_risky_users WHERE site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM entra_risky_users WHERE risk_state = 'confirmedCompromised' AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM entra_risk_detections WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND detected_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND detected_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_mfa_registered) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) FROM entra_mfa_registration WHERE site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM entra_mfa_registration WHERE is_admin AND NOT is_mfa_registered AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT site_label AS "Site", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_mfa_registered) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS "MFA %" FROM entra_mfa_registration WHERE site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2

SELECT upn AS "User", site_label AS "Site", risk_level AS "Risk", risk_state AS "State", risk_detail AS "Detail", risk_last_updated AS "Updated", tenant AS "Tenant" FROM entra_risky_users WHERE site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, risk_last_updated DESC

SELECT detected_at AS "Detected", upn AS "User", site_label AS "Site", risk_event_type AS "Type", risk_level AS "Risk", risk_state AS "State", ip_address AS "IP", concat_ws(', ', city, country) AS "Location" FROM entra_risk_detections WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND detected_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND detected_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'signins' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'mfa_failures' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'legacy_auth' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'risky_signins' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'ca_failures' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
